title: Language Models Are Borrowing-Blind: A Multilingual Evaluation of Loanword Identification across 10 Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the ability of large language models and pretrained multilingual encoders to explicitly distinguish and identify loanwords versus native vocabulary across 10 diverse languages using a sequence labeling task (BIO tagging) under zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuning setups.
